name: PackageGuard
help: PackageGuard scans the NuGet, npm, Yarn and pnpm dependencies of a solution or project against an allow- or deny-list, so you can control which open-source licenses and package versions are acceptable. It can also print a colored risk summary, generate HTML/SARIF risk reports, and produce a Software Bill of Materials.

properties.name: ProjectPath
properties.help: The path to a directory containing a <c>.sln</c>/<c>.slnx</c> file and/or a <c>package.json</c>, a specific <c>.sln</c>/<c>.slnx</c> file, a specific <c>.csproj</c> file, or a specific <c>package.json</c>. Defaults to the current working directory.

properties.name: ConfigPath
properties.help: The path to the configuration file. Defaults to hierarchical discovery of <c>packageguard.config.json</c> or <c>.packageguard/config.json</c> files starting from the solution directory.

properties.name: Interactive
properties.help: Enables interactive mode for <c>dotnet restore</c>. Enabled by default.

properties.name: IgnoreViolations
properties.help: Don't fail the analysis if any violations are found.

properties.name: ForceRestore
properties.help: Force restoring the NuGet dependencies, even if the lockfile is up-to-date.

properties.name: SkipRestore
properties.help: Prevent the restore operation from running, even if the lock file is missing or out-of-date.

properties.name: GitHubApiKey
properties.help: GitHub API key to use for fetching package licenses. If not specified, you may run into GitHub's rate limiting issues.

properties.name: UseCaching
properties.help: Maintains a cache of the package information to speed up future analysis.

properties.name: CacheFilePath
properties.help: Overrides the file path where analysis data is cached. Defaults to a <c>.packageguard/cache.bin</c> file relative to the working directory.

properties.name: RefreshRiskCache
properties.help: Force <c>--report-risk</c> to rebuild risk-related package data instead of reusing cached risk entries.

properties.name: RiskCacheMaxAgeHours
properties.help: Maximum age in hours for cached risk-related package data before <c>--report-risk</c> refreshes it. Defaults to <c>24</c>.

properties.name: ScanNuGet
properties.help: Explicitly enable scanning for <c>.csproj</c>, <c>.sln</c> or <c>.slnx</c> files. Enabled by default.

properties.name: NpmPackageManager
properties.help: Explicitly specify the package manager to use (<c>Npm</c>, <c>Yarn</c>, <c>Pnpm</c>), or <c>None</c> to disable npm scanning entirely. If not specified, it is detected automatically.

properties.name: NpmExePath
properties.help: The path to the npm, yarn or pnpm executable. If not specified, the system PATH is used.

properties.name: ReportRisk
properties.help: Show a colored risk summary in the console and generate detailed HTML/SARIF risk reports.

properties.name: Verbose
properties.help: Enable verbose (debug-level) logging output. Combine with <c>--report-risk</c> to see individual HTTP calls to GitHub, OSV, and npm registries.

properties.name: Sbom
properties.help: Generate a Software Bill of Materials for the resolved dependency graph, in the given format. Requires <c>--sbom-output</c>.

properties.name: SbomOutput
properties.help: The output file path for the generated SBOM. Required when <c>--sbom</c> is specified.
